use: 报错超载透明立绘，每人一张，以各自base为设定和风格参考
common_constraints: One centered full-body chibi; preserve exact character design, outfit, colors, proportions and illustration style from base; cute overwhelmed/wilted reaction, not injured or sick. Entire hair, ears/horns, wings, tail and feet visible. True alpha transparency. No background, text, food, UI or extra characters.

characters.direction: Proud tsundere white dragon girl reluctantly overwhelmed: flushed cheeks, dizzy unfocused lavender eyes, tiny wobbly mouth, shoulders drooping, one hand pressed to forehead, wings and tail drooping. Dignified and stubborn.

Composed science prodigy with brain overload: sitting back on heels, head tilted down, dazed amber eyes, embarrassed frown, one hand rubbing temple and other arm hugging closed book. Wilted but politely elegant.

Playful catgirl suddenly overloaded: ears flattened sideways, red and gold eyes swirling/dazed, tiny crooked mouth, hunched shoulders, limp exhausted paws in front, drooping tail. Expressive comedic reaction, not sleeping.

Lazy blue whale girl running out of brainpower: half-lidded unfocused blue eyes, flat wobbly mouth, forward lean, sagging fin ears and shoulders, pen and notebook held loosely, tail flopped downward. Defeated and cute, no food.
